gaps: Existing Gainsight APIs expose raw customer success endpoints; this print packages command discovery, agent defaults, local sync/search, SQL analytics, and MCP access.
patterns: Customer success workflows benefit from compact JSON, --agent defaults, local SQLite mirrors, deterministic command discovery, and read-first MCP tools.

novel_features.name: Local SQLite mirror
novel_features.description: Sync read endpoints into a local SQLite store for offline search, joins, and repeatable agent analysis.
novel_features.rationale: Agent-native CLI affordance shipped in this print.

novel_features.name: Full-text search across API data
novel_features.description: Search live or locally synced Gainsight records from one agent-friendly command.
novel_features.rationale: Agent-native CLI affordance shipped in this print.

novel_features.name: SQL analytics on synced records
novel_features.description: Run read-only SQL against the local store for compound questions the upstream API does not expose directly.
novel_features.rationale: Agent-native CLI affordance shipped in this print.

narrative.headline: Gainsight read workflows for agents that need customer success context.
narrative.value_prop: Wraps Gainsight read APIs with agent defaults, local SQLite sync, search, analytics, command discovery, and MCP tools so agents can inspect customer success data, health scores, Cockpit CTAs, success plans, and timeline activity without hand-building HTTP calls.
